description: Salesforce is a cloud-based customer relationship management platform that enables businesses to manage sales, customer service, marketing, and enterprise workflows.

evidence.claim: Salesforce supports OAuth 2.0 authentication flows including JWT bearer token and web server authorization.
Developers can instantly sign up for a free full-featured Salesforce Developer Edition account to access APIs.
Salesforce offers REST APIs and GraphQL APIs providing full access to standard and custom CRM objects.
Community-maintained Model Context Protocol servers exist for Salesforce API integration.
Composio features an official toolkit for Salesforce integration with AI agents.

research_notes: Salesforce is ideal for AI agent toolkit integration given its free self-serve developer accounts, extensive REST and GraphQL APIs, standard OAuth 2.0 auth flows, and existing Composio toolkit.
